# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 84 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 49 | Coptic

---

## Saying 84

Jesus said: "When you catch sight of your own reflection, you feel joy. But when you encounter your true images — the ones that existed before you, that neither die nor show themselves — how much do you think you could handle?"

---

**Translator's Notes (PNEUMA):**

- "Catch sight of your own reflection" — the mirror experience made vivid
- "Encounter your true images" — the pre-existent archetypes as the "true" images
- "How much do you think you could handle?" — colloquial rendering of the overwhelming question
